title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions on Israeli sport from the last few days — an Olympic gold in Tokyo, a Croatian snub in the NBA, a penalty-shootout hero in Belgium, a Europa League rout, and a duet in the Paris pool.

questions.question: By how many points did Linoy Ashram beat Dina Averina to win gold in the rhythmic gymnastics individual all-around final at the Tokyo Olympics?
questions.explanation: Ashram scored 107.800 to Averina's 107.650, a margin of 0.150 points, on 7 August 2021 at the Ariake Gymnastics Centre.

questions.question: Which NBA team did Mario Hezonja sign with, turning down an approach from Israeli club Hapoel Tel Aviv?
questions.explanation: Hezonja signed a one-year, reportedly $2.8 million contract with the Cleveland Cavaliers instead of joining Hapoel Tel Aviv for the EuroLeague season.

questions.question: How did Israeli winger Anan Khalaili help Union Saint-Gilloise win the 2026 Belgian Super Cup over Club Brugge?
answers: He scored the opening goal in the 49th minute
He came on as a 61st-minute substitute and scored his penalty in the shootout
He was sent off before the penalty shootout
He set up the equaliser with a corner kick
questions.explanation: Khalaili came on as a 61st-minute substitute and scored his kick as Union won the shootout 5-4 after a 1-1 draw.

questions.question: What was the aggregate score as Maccabi Tel Aviv defeated Sheriff Tiraspol to reach the Europa League third qualifying round?
questions.explanation: Maccabi won 5-0 away and 1-0 at home (Roy Revivo scoring the second-leg goal) for a 6-0 aggregate.

questions.question: Where did Israel's Katy Konin and Aya Mazor finish in the women's duet technical routine final at the 2026 European Aquatics Championships in Paris?
questions.explanation: The Israeli duo scored 260.6284 points to finish 10th of 19 nations, ahead of Georgia, Switzerland, Turkey and Bulgaria.
